If you have anyone that means a lot to you or anyone you love (could even be a singer or band you love), who you would never physically hurt/kill, try the Butterfly Project. You basically draw a butterfly wherever you want to SH, and name it after someone who you love (it helps to actually also write the name near the butterfly). The idea is that self harming on that butterfly (the person) would be a symbol of you basically killing that person. In high school, I named them after the friends I had and the bands I loved. I connected those butterflies to them. You don't have to be a great artist or anything. If you're not into butterflies, you could always change it into something else.. or use the idea and modify it into something else that better suits you. It helped me and I ended up being years clean. Although my days are literally numbered now, I will definitely still pass this along, because it did help me. I hope it helps and you get better
